tagline.en: Cheap per-GB data from the NordVPN team, plans from $3.99
tagline.zh: NordVPN 团队出品，按 GB 算便宜，3.99 美元起

description.en: Saily comes from the NordVPN team and it shows: no ads in the app, DNS filtering that blocks malicious domains while you roam, and per-gigabyte prices that often come in under Airalo. The catalogue covers 150+ destinations. Roughly the whole product is data. Numbers are a US-only add-on at US$0.99 a month since June 2026.
description.zh: Saily 出自 NordVPN 团队，痕迹很明显：App 里没有广告，漫游时内置 DNS 过滤会拦恶意域名，每 GB 单价常常比 Airalo 低。目录覆盖 150+ 目的地。整个产品基本只有流量，号码是唯一的附加项，2026 年 6 月起只有美国号，0.99 美元/月。

details.en:
Saily's pitch is a trusted name in privacy applied to travel data: the Nord Security team built it, and the app carries that DNA — clean onboarding, no ads, and built-in DNS-level filtering that blocks known malicious domains while you roam.

Plans are classic data buckets (1 / 3 / 5 / 10 / 20 GB) with 7-day minimum validity, extendable by top-up, and a flexible renewal model where unused data can roll over on auto-renewing plans in supported destinations.

Coverage spans 150+ destinations with multi-network routing in many markets, which reduces dead zones compared with single-network local plans.

The app supports installing the eSIM before travel and activating on arrival, and support is in-app chat. Saily frequently bundles promos (e.g. first-plan discounts) and the price per GB undercuts Airalo on many routes, though phone numbers are currently US-only (US$0.99/month since June 2026) and unlimited plans, along with the Saily Ultra subscription, arrived only in 2026.

If you already live in the Nord ecosystem (NordVPN, NordPass), the single-account experience is the most seamless on this list.

## US phone number as a second line

Since June 2026 Saily has offered a dedicated US (+1) number inside the app. Official pricing is a monthly subscription — the number page lists US$1.99/mo (launch pricing from US$0.99/mo), with call/text plans from US$0.99 — and identity verification (document + selfie) is required in the app after purchase. The number itself carries no data or minutes: it is for registrations, SMS verification codes and 2FA on US-only services.

A Thailand-based user reported a successful field test (WeChat, 2026-10, single-user, unverified): charged 238.09 THB (~US$6.99) via KBank Visa for what the app presented as a one-year number fee, passed international KYC with a non-US passport and selfie, and used the number to receive PayPal verification SMS on a Thai iPhone — no US residency required, no country restriction observed. Official pages show monthly pricing only, so treat the ~US$6.99/year figure as a community report (possibly an in-app or regional promo) until Saily publishes an annual tier.
details.zh:
Saily 的卖点是隐私领域的可靠品牌切入旅行流量：由 Nord Security 团队打造，App 也继承了这一基因——引导流程清爽、无广告，并内置 DNS 级过滤，漫游时自动拦截已知恶意域名，公共网络场景多一层防护。

套餐是经典的流量桶（1 / 3 / 5 / 10 / 20 GB），有效期最少 7 天，可续购延长；在支持自动续费的目的地上，未用完的流量可结转到下个周期。

覆盖 150+ 目的地，不少市场支持多网络智能选路——设备会在可用运营商间自动挑选信号更好的一家，相比单网络本地包能减少盲区。

App 支持出发前先装好 eSIM、落地后一键激活，客服为应用内聊天。Saily 经常有首单折扣类促销，多数线路的每 GB 单价低于 Airalo；但注意电话号码目前仅支持美国（2026 年 6 月起 0.99 美元/月），不限量套餐与 Saily Ultra 订阅也是 2026 年才上线的新选项。

如果你已在 Nord 生态（NordVPN、NordPass）里，同一账号的体验是这份名单里最顺滑的。

## 美国号码副号线

2026 年 6 月起 Saily 在 App 内提供专用美国（+1）号码。官方定价为按月订阅——号码页标价 US$1.99/月（上线价 0.99 美元/月起），通话/短信计划 0.99 美元起——购买后需在 App 内完成身份认证（证件 + 人脸自拍）。号码本身不含流量和通话分钟，用途是海外平台注册、接收短信验证码与 2FA。

一位泰国用户实测成功（微信记录，2026-10，单用户、未核实）：通过 KBank Visa 支付 238.09 泰铢（约 6.99 美元），App 内显示为一年号码使用费；用非美国护照完成国际 KYC 认证后激活，在泰版 iPhone 上正常添加 eSIM 并成功接收 PayPal 验证短信——无需美国居留，未见国家限制。官方页面仅列月付价，"约 6.99 美元/年"按社区实测口径对待（可能是 App 内或地区性促销），以 Saily 官方公布为准。

bestFor.en: People already paying for NordVPN, and anyone who wants cheap data with nothing else bolted on.
bestFor.zh: 已经在用 NordVPN 的人，或者只想要便宜流量、不要任何附加功能的人。

validity.zh: 按月订阅（社区实测约6.99美元/年档，未核实）

plansNote.en: Saily's storefront is behind a bot challenge, so per-destination plan tables are not republished here. Data bucket sizes and validity are stable; prices vary by destination and promo. US number pricing verified on saily.com/esim-phone-number and the June 2026 launch release (2026-10-10): US$1.99/mo page price, launch pricing from US$0.99/mo, in-app KYC required.
plansNote.zh: Saily 商店有反爬验证，此处不转载逐目的地套餐表。流量档位与有效期稳定，价格随目的地与促销浮动。 美国号码价格经 saily.com/esim-phone-number 与 2026 年 6 月上线新闻稿核实（2026-10-10）：页面价 US$1.99/月、上线价 0.99 美元/月起，App 内需 KYC。

en: Same team as NordVPN, so privacy handling is not an afterthought
DNS filtering blocks malicious domains while roaming
App is clean and ad-free, and supports installing before you fly
zh: 与 NordVPN 同团队，隐私处理不是事后补的
漫游时 DNS 过滤拦截恶意域名
App 干净无广告，支持出发前预装
每 GB 单价经常比 Airalo 低

en: Numbers are US-only: US$0.99/month since June 2026, nothing for other destinations
Unlimited plans and the Ultra subscription only arrived in 2026; the catalogue was fixed data buckets before that
The storefront blocks scrapers, so third-party price tracking is thin
Saily does not publish annual number pricing; the ~US$6.99/year figure is one user report (Oct 2026, unverified)
zh: 号码只有美国：2026 年 6 月起 0.99 美元/月，其它目的地没有
不限量套餐和 Ultra 订阅都是 2026 年才有的，此前只有固定流量桶
商店反爬，第三方价格追踪很少
官方没公布号码年付价，「约 6.99 美元/年」是单个用户的说法（2026-10，未核实）

note.en: No reliable public evidence of Saily's exit-IP country or type. Nord Security's own blog only describes traffic passing carrier servers to the internet without naming breakout locations; a Reddit summary of the USENIX study lists Saily among providers NOT routing via Chinese networks. Treat as unverified.
note.zh: 未找到 Saily 出口 IP 国家/性质的可靠公开口径。官方博客只说流量经运营商服务器出公网，未披露落地；Reddit 转述的 USENIX 研究摘要将 Saily 列为不经中国网络的一档。标为未核实。
